findings.claim: The observed window is the score-time grid 0.0-0.49 with a declared learning window [0.0,0.5]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior is used, so no absolute affinity label is available inside the observed support.

The curve-support selection rule is a signed, multiplicity-controlled enrichment criterion (absolute integrated z >= 0.1, batch direction fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05, scale floor excluded) and it selected 24 landmark contrast features; this is selection enrichment of signed favorable-versus-comparison contrasts, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

The information audit is explicitly not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian; its nonnegative excess-distance metrics are by construction and not a causal affinity effect, and teacher score correlations are observational, not a validated affinity predictor.

Terminal credit exists only as a separate terminal-credit-mining table with terminal score time 0.99 and state time 1.0, outside the observed window; multiple testing is BH over 400 survival field/measure tests and is not terminal affinity effects, so last-record survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 of 700 batch nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, with at most 2 teachers per batch, so descendant survival credit is survivor-biased and cannot be treated as an unbiased later-label estimate.

Independent-batch reproducibility is available (14 independent batches) and the audit reports leave-one-batch exclusion, so batch agreement and opposing observations can be checked before prioritizing any coordinate rule.

hypotheses.direction: increase weight on the signed contrast of the selected landmark features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.falsifier: a selected landmark feature whose batch direction fraction falls below the selection threshold or whose sign reverses across independent batches
hypotheses.observable: signed integrated contrast z of the selected landmark features over score times 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.scope: observed window only; selection enrichment, not an absolute geometric descriptor
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at the observed selection nodes, restricted to the 24 curve-support-selected landmark features, carry reproducible directional information over the complete observed window.

hypotheses.direction: down-weight directions whose selection contrast is not corroborated by descendant survival credit
hypotheses.falsifier: a feature where selection contrast and descendant survival credit agree in sign across all 14 independent batches
hypotheses.observable: sign agreement between selection-node contrast and descendant survival effect for the same feature
hypotheses.scope: observed window plus terminal-credit table; terminal credit is not final affinity
hypotheses.statement: Immediate selection evidence and available descendant survival credit may disagree, and that disagreement should reorder direction priorities rather than be averaged into a single target.

hypotheses.direction: constrain only the selected landmark regions and leave surrounding coordinates free
hypotheses.falsifier: a joint diagnostic showing the selected landmark region adds no information beyond common motion
hypotheses.observable: joint-diagnostic or adjusted-region effect for the selected landmarks versus common-motion components
hypotheses.scope: coordinate control only; no claim of an adjustment the supplied tool did not perform
hypotheses.statement: Local landmark coordinate information should be separated from global pose and shape, retaining freedom in surrounding coordinates rather than averaging incompatible conformations.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; final predicted target affinity is the declared objective but no outcome evaluation data are available to either role.
The information audit is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, and its excess-distance metrics are nonnegative by construction, so they cannot be read as causal affinity effects.
Teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor.
Terminal-credit multiple testing covers 400 survival field/measure tests and is not terminal affinity effects; last-record credit is not final affinity benefit.
Ancestral coverage is sparse (349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors, 531 with fewer than 6), so descendant survival credit is survivor-biased.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed or evaluated here.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Interpret the supplied evidence and answer the coordinate-design task.
